title: Grade 5 1.07
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 5: Identify factors of a number | Distinguish factors and non-factors | Identify factor pairs | Identify factors using division | Understand properties of factors | Determine all factors of a number | List factors of a number | Identify numbers from their factors | Use factors to solve equations | Determine a number from its factors | Compare numbers using factors | Apply factors in real-world contexts
